measurementPolicy: rawCount must equal 10; midpoint median; nearest-rank p95; shopping 65/100ms; range/drag/transfer 160/160ms; save auxiliary has no response threshold
limitations: Frame PNG/trace hashes and correlations are not reverified by this helper; canonical verifier remains authoritative
A within-budget numeric timing is not a pass when its producer failed, its artifact is incomplete, or canonical verification failed
Missing later groups stay missing if the canonical runner stopped after an earlier failure
